title: Director of AI at IT Services Provider Sees NVIDIA-Related Business Growing 40%–60% in 2026
expert: Director of AI at a global IT services provider (88,000 staff); current; first-hand allocation, lead times, quoted pricing and deployments
verdict: An IT-services AI director (88,000-staff integrator) saw NVIDIA-related business grow 60%-100% y/y in Aug–Oct 2026, with supply still allocation-bound and customers placing deposits for 2028 slots.

Duration of the AI capex cycle: 🟢 **60%-100% y/y NVIDIA-related growth in Aug–Oct 2026** (first-hand), ahead of the expert's own 40%-60% CY26 forecast; first expert read on this page. → Tenet 1 (capex duration) ↑
🟢 **Customers placing 2028 pre-allocation requests with deposits**; consistent with hyperscaler 3Q capex +87% y/y (SB #66113). → Tenet 1 (capex duration) ↑
Lead times / air-pocket risk: 🟢 **Lead times T+90 to T+100+ days; supply "as tight as 90 days ago"**, with NVIDIA meeting but not exceeding allocation; consistent with reported neocloud Vera Rubin allocation cuts of up to 50% (SB #65967). → Tenet 6 (supply execution) ↑
Rubin ramp execution: 🟢 **B300-class at 55%-65% of new Q3 nodes**; Vera Rubin gives ~2x tokens for a **20%-30% premium** (hearsay), in line with Edgewater's 17-20% rack price rises (SB #62065). → Tenet 5 (margins) ↑
Compute share vs. XPU/ASIC: 🟡 **AMD Helios: "hundreds of racks" ordered by neoclouds** for inference since Q2 2026 software parity (hearsay); consistent with MI355X ~2x B200 perf/\$ on Kimi K3 (SB #65425). → Tenet 3 (~75% share) ↓

changes: Vera Rubin 20%-30% price premium (hearsay) vs Edgewater's expected 17-20% GB300/VR200 rack price rises in Apr-27 (SB #62065, 2026-10-27): consistent.
Supply "as tight as 90 days ago", allocation met exactly, vs reported NVIDIA cuts of up to 50% to neocloud Vera Rubin allocations (SB #65967, 2026-11-02): consistent (tight supply).
AMD neocloud orders of hundreds of racks (hearsay) vs MI355X up to 2x B200 perf/\$ on Kimi K3 (SB #65425, 2026-10-31): consistent (AMD gaining in inference).
Site-readiness delays <3% of the expert's orders vs SemiAnalysis's estimate that 5.8GW of US capacity could be delayed (SB #66252, 2026-11-04): **conflicting** (today's sites vs a forward estimate).
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (capex duration): ↑ — 60%-100% y/y growth in Aug–Oct; customers placing 2028 pre-allocation deposits.
Tenet 3 (~75% share): ↓ — AMD has hundreds of neocloud inference racks on order (hearsay).
Tenet 5 (margins mid-70s): ↑ — Vera Rubin ~2x tokens at a 20%-30% premium; offset risk from storage/memory input costs +60%.
Tenet 6 (supply executes Rubin): → — supply tight with T+90 day lead times, site delays <3%; Vera Rubin enterprise shipments start late November.
